_meta.role: Software Engineer: Intern Opportunities for University Students - CoreAI

summary: M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology, with hands-on experience building AI/ML systems end to end, from a Transformer and ASR model implemented from scratch in PyTorch to a voice-controlled robotic system that integrates speech, language, and vision models into one agentic pipeline. Comfortable adopting new AI frameworks and tools quickly, including using Claude Code directly in day-to-day development. Background spans deep learning, model optimization, and applied AI research across five internships.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system across a three-layer pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson+Arduino controller) over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing with ToF-based contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline (mel spectrogram encoder, causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention) trained on NPTEL Indian-English speech data, achieving 15% WER.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, with <1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
